# SUMMARY: This series contain 36 samples obtained from human lung tissue and includes the following: 7 Adenocarcinoma samples. 16 Squamous cell carcinoma samples. 1 AdenoSquamous sample. 2 Renal Metastasis. 1 Colon metastasis. 7 normal lung tissue adjacent to the tumors. 2 commercial normal lung RNA.
